label: continuation-evidence-digest-audit
command:
import json, shutil, subprocess
from collections import Counter
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.costs import aggregate_commands
from nisayon.engine.io import file_digest
root=Path.cwd()
continuation=json.loads((root/"work/continuations/engine-2026-09-19.json").read_text())
identities=continuation["command_records"]
assert len(identities)==len(set(identities))
records=[]
retention=[]
base=root/"docs/experiments/results/engine-continuation-checks-001"
for identity in identities:
    source=root/".nisayon/runs"/identity
    retained=base/identity
    retained.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    record=json.loads((source/"run.json").read_text())
    assert record["schema"]=="nisayon.run.v1" and record["id"]==identity
    assert record["process_status"] != "running"
    for name in ["run.json",*record["logs"]]:
        before=source/name
        after=retained/name
        if not after.exists():
            shutil.copyfile(before,after)
        assert before.read_bytes()==after.read_bytes(), (identity,name)
        if name in record["logs"]:
            assert file_digest(after)==record["logs"][name]["sha256"]
            assert after.stat().st_size==record["logs"][name]["bytes"]
    records.append(record)
    retention.append({"id":identity,"record":{"path":str((retained/"run.json").relative_to(root)),"sha256":file_digest(retained/"run.json")},"logs_verified":list(record["logs"])})
inventory=json.loads((root/"docs/experiments/results/retained-declarations-002/retained-location.json").read_text())
packet_root=Path(inventory["root"])
for name,expected in inventory["files"].items():
    path=packet_root/name
    assert file_digest(path)==expected["sha256"] and path.stat().st_size==expected["bytes"], name
sample=json.loads((root/"artifacts/robolab-reproduced-source-001/manifest.json").read_text())
for record in sample["records"]:
    path=root/"artifacts/robolab-reproduced-source-001"/record["path"]
    assert file_digest(path)==record["sha256"] and path.stat().st_size==record["bytes"]
import_path=root/"artifacts/robolab-import-006/external-record.json"
summary=json.loads((root/"docs/experiments/results/robolab-record-001/summary-distinct-frames.json").read_text())
assert file_digest(import_path)==summary["full_import"]["sha256"]
document=json.loads(import_path.read_text())
assert document["reader"]["module_sha256"]==file_digest(root/"src/nisayon/engine/robolab_record.py")
wheel=json.loads((root/"docs/experiments/results/engine-wheel-001/check.json").read_text())
assert wheel["full_import_sha256"]==file_digest(import_path)
assert file_digest(root/"artifacts/engine-wheel-001/nisayon_workspace-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl")==wheel["wheel_sha256"]
unchanged=["src/nisayon/evaluation","tests/evaluation","docs/evaluation","work/lanes/fable5.md","reproduction/sources","docs/experiments/results/development-ablation-001","docs/experiments/results/bounded-agent-comparison-001"]
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--exit-code","21ed4f6a8d8c1f1acbef1036d8f7d31f83e29755","HEAD","--",*unchanged],check=True,capture_output=True)
costs={"schema":"nisayon.engine-continuation-costs.v1","recorded_at":datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),"original_mission_start":continuation["original_mission_start"],"continuation_start":continuation["started_at"],"scope":"Explicitly retained continuation command walls; historical experiment costs are separate. This audit and subsequent closeout commands are added after they complete.","command_records":[{"id":r["id"],"label":r["label"],"process_status":r["process_status"],"wall_seconds":r["wall_seconds"],"parent_command_record_id":r.get("parent_command_record_id"),"record_sha256":file_digest(root/".nisayon/runs"/r["id"]/"run.json")} for r in records],**aggregate_commands(records),"process_status_counts":dict(Counter(r["process_status"] for r in records)),"new_simulator_executions":0,"new_model_calls":0,"source_download_bytes":continuation["source_download_bytes"],"unknown_costs":continuation["unknown_costs"],"active_work_seconds":None,"resource_cost_is_not_elapsed_or_active_time":True}
(base/"cost-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(costs,indent=2)+"\n")
result={"schema":"nisayon.engine-retention-audit.v1","recorded_at":datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),"command_records":retention,"native_packet_inventory_files_verified":len(inventory["files"]),"pinned_source_members_verified":len(sample["records"]),"full_import_sha256":file_digest(import_path),"reader_source_sha256":document["reader"]["module_sha256"],"wheel_sha256":wheel["wheel_sha256"],"unchanged_from_startup_commit":unchanged,"integrity_scope":"Local bytes and source identities only; not physical truth, independent custody, experimental effectiveness or an effort measurement."}
(base/"retention-audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"command_records_verified":len(records),"known_command_wall_sum_s":costs["known_command_wall_sum_s"],"native_inventory_files_verified":len(inventory["files"]),"source_members_verified":len(sample["records"]),"status_counts":costs["process_status_counts"]},indent=2))
cost_boundary: wall time for this command; human time and external costs unmeasured
